name: meaningless tragedy
source:
"They put something inside me,

it's been growing,

and it hurts. It hurts like nothing else.

Help me, sister.

Help me make it make sense."

[From [url=https://treyfoil.itch.io/meaningless-tragedy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“他们在我体内放了一些东西，

它一直在增长，

很痛。没有什么比这更痛的了。

帮帮我吧，姐姐。

帮我让它变得有意义。”

[来自[url=https://treyfoil.itch.io/meaningless-tragedy]itch.io[/url]]
